findings.title: Placed cups turn abundance into reachable hospitality

The supplied 88:12-16 sequence contributes source, rest, adjacency, and spread; the earlier administered drink and the supplied no-control context contribute the separate agency contrast. Direct cup-and-service parallels at 56:18 and 76:15 reinforce the source-to-user contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The cups become the handoff from environmental abundance to personal access, and hospitality becomes visible as arranged availability rather than a decorative inventory.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains cups set in the garden. The packet does not state who filled or served them, so filling and service are inferred from the sequence. The agency reversal remains qualified by the supplied uncertainty record, and the furnishing-chain relation is a bounded global resonance rather than a surah thesis.
